intent: Cross the valley floor, ascend grassy and rocky slopes, reach the upper meadow and descend a long sunlit hillside. Expert redesign: slope cutters and exposed terrace fans.

sections.name: The valley floor
sections.lesson: Low jumps lead to the rising hillside. Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

signs.text:
The valley floor
Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

sections.name: The grassy incline
sections.lesson: Aim diagonally up the stepping hillside. Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

signs.text:
The grassy incline
Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

sections.name: The rocky sun slope
sections.lesson: Larger diagonal gaps climb the exposed rock. Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

signs.text:
The rocky sun slope
Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

sections.name: The bright upper meadow
sections.lesson: Catch your rhythm on the broad upper meadow. Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

signs.text:
The bright upper meadow
Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

sections.name: The long downhill
sections.lesson: Carry each landing into the next descending terrace. Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

signs.text:
The long downhill
Let the cutter finish its sweep before crossing.

difficulty.verification_profile: default movement and charge dash, horizontal 1.5, unassisted
